base_margin: logit(clip(price, 1e-4, 1-1e-4)); price = last trade before the cutoff, clipped to [0.01, 0.99]
trained: kaggle/xmarket/train_xmarket.py (XM_LOCAL=1, Mac CPU), 351,244 settled Kalshi markets from the TrevorJS/kalshi-trades mirror; fit 2021-07..2025-12-11, val 2025-12-13..2026-01-03 (early stopping), test 2026-01-05..2026-01-30
live_notes: close_ts in training is the ACTUAL close of a settled market. Markets with can_close_early (sports games) close right after the event, but an open market's close_time is the latest expiration (days later). Live: use expected_expiration_time when can_close_early, else close_time.
h only took the values 24, 6 and 1 in training: score live markets near those horizons and pass the snapped value.
price = last TRADE price (not a quote); n_tr/ct/vwap_all use every trade since the market opened, so paginate /markets/trades (cursor) instead of stopping at 1,000 trades.

series not in series_cats -> '_rare'; series not in series_map -> engine/vendor/jb_categories.get_hierarchy(series)[:2] (it reproduces series_map exactly); a category not in cat_cats -> missing (NaN).
